analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates curling and styling her long brunette hair using the pink WavyTalk thermal brush at home with a 30% off limited-time promotion.
analysis.full_description: The video features a young woman styling her long, layered dark hair using a pink thermal round brush (WavyTalk Blowout Boost). Set to Etta James' song 'At Last', she begins by curling her front fringe/bangs and releasing a bouncy curl, before demonstrating section by section how she curls the lengths of her hair away from her face. Text overlays highlight achieving a salon-quality blowout at home and advertise a limited-time 30% discount. In the final frames, she tosses and fluffs her voluminous blowout while admiring the results.

on_screen_text.text: POV you achieve the most perfect blowouts at home 💖

Limited-Time 30% OFF
Buy Now, Save on Salon Visits Instantly

scenes.visual: Young woman in a white buttoned top curling her front bang section downward and outward using the pink thermal blowout brush, then releasing it and tossing her voluminous hair.
scenes.action: Curling bangs with the thermal brush and flicking hair into place.

scenes.visual: A promotional banner overlay appears above. The creator takes a side strand of hair, wraps it tightly around the thermal barrel, holds, and unrolls it into a smooth spiral wave.
scenes.action: Sectioning and curling side hair strand with the thermal round brush.

scenes.visual: Creator takes another mid-section strand, rolls the tool through to smooth and curl the ends outward, uncoiling the brush with a twisting motion.
scenes.action: Styling and twisting hair sections around the heated barrel.

scenes.visual: Creator puts down the tool, runs her fingers through her hair, shakes out the voluminous curls, and poses looking into the camera.
scenes.action: Fluffing and showing off the finished voluminous bouncy blowout.

hook.first_frame: Creator rolling the pink thermal brush through her bangs with on-screen text 'POV you achieve the most perfect blowouts at home 💖'.
hook.visual_0_3s: Creator rotating the heated round brush through her front fringe, releasing a smooth blowout curve.
hook.text_0_3s: POV you achieve the most perfect blowouts at home 💖
